candidates.rationale: Directly casts skb->data to a VLAN header pointer without first calling pskb_may_pull() to ensure that at least VLAN_HLEN bytes are in the linear area. If insufficient data exists, this creates an out-of-bounds pointer.
Dereferences the vlan pointer obtained from skb->data; if the VLAN header is not fully linear, this reads beyond the valid data, causing an out-of-bounds read.
Pulls VLAN_HLEN bytes from the skb assuming the data is present. Without a prior pskb_may_pull(), this can corrupt the skb's internal data pointers if there is insufficient linear data.
Relies on skb->data after an unchecked pull. If the pull was performed on insufficient linear data, the network header is set at an incorrect offset, leading to further corruption.
